title: Adobe security advisory (AV26-1205)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1205 Date: November 25, 2026 As of November 24, 2026, Adobe is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Cloud Service (CS) Prior to or equal to 2026.11.29643 Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) 6.5 Prior to or equal to Service Pack 26 / 25 / 24 - Cumulative Hotfix for GRANITE-76751 Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) 6.5 LTS Prior to or equal to Service Pack 3 / 2 / 1 - Cumulative Hotfix for GRANITE-76751 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Adobe Security Bulletin Adobe Security Bulletins and Advisories Article Link: Adobe security advisory (AV26-1205) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
